blockingFindings.description: Direct inspection of all eleven V148 views shows the skirt front remains severely crumpled in neutral/front/three-quarter and arm poses. In crouch and sit the overskirt lifts/opening exposes large block-like thigh-cover surfaces and the front panels do not form a controlled hem transition. Pose-matched coverage remains low: overskirt upper-thigh coverage is 0.356 per side in crouch and 0.240/0.243 in sit. Duplicate canonical seam positions now remain coincident at 0 m in neutral/crouch/sit, but this does not resolve the visible panel silhouette, coverage gaps, or fit.

Neutral front and three-quarter views still show the separate front panels heavily wrinkled and visually obscure the pleat design. The back/side read as a broad conical shell with a hard straight hem; front/side views retain uneven folds and a broken hem outline. Do not accept silhouette based solely on duplicate-seam continuity.

Front, side, three-quarter, arm-cross, and crouch renders continue to show angular/sharp triangular surface artifacts along the torso and an abrupt waist-to-hip shelf. This is still a visible appearance blocker independent of the improved shared seam weights.

outOfScope: VRChat Build & Test and runtime inspection
